caveats.flight call: Measured across a corpus boundary that predicts the label. crow-tools has no flight-call flag, so all 40 positives come from the archive set — and the two corpora are trivially separable in this feature, since crow-tools pools a single 3s window (std=0) and the archive set pools whole clips. See experiments/0025 --preflight.
caveats.co-occurrence: A one-vs-rest head's probabilities are independent and do not sum to one. Do not argmax them and call the result a confidence.
